static_traits.educational_background: Pursuing degrees in philosophy and history

basic_info.main_problem: 我正为关于我破损眼镜的负面想法而困扰,认为修理have not意义,因为我not会喜欢任何其他眼镜.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts about glasses affect my daily life and decisions; I find it hard to handle them alone, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 约一年前,Jessica将朋友画成'小马宝莉'角色,期待他们会喜欢并感到惊喜,但朋友的反应并not积极或兴奋.她当时感到像被重击一样的失望与尴尬,开始质疑自己的画画能力.自那以后,她在分享作品时变得Anxiety,担心负面反馈,做画时会反复Self-doubt,出现'have not人会喜欢''I am not good enough'等想法.

core_beliefs: 如果他人not喜欢我的作品,就说明I am not good enough
have not其他眼镜会让我满意

special_situations.event: When considering going to the shop to repair or replace glasses, or when glasses-related topics come up
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果找not到与当前眼镜一样好或更好的选择,修理或更换就have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避行动,迟迟not去修理或试戴新镜框
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 修也not用,我not会喜欢任何其他眼镜

special_situations.event: Glasses recently broke, forced to temporarily fix them with tiger-pattern tape
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once the glasses break, it means the overall experience will worsen and be hard to restore to a satisfactory state
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 聚焦在not便与挫败上,忽视可能的解决方案(如维修或更换)

special_situations.event: 想到将作品分享给他人或Anticipation他人的反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not喜欢,就证明I am not good enough,not值得继续创作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing, over-censors oneself, repeatedly agonizes and procrastinates
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人会喜欢这个/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Being distracted by glasses problems in class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as distracted by the glasses problem, study performance is affected and hard to recover
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immersed in worry, hard to switch attention to class content

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and liked (work appreciated, choices affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate,被评判与再次失望
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and self-esteem by avoiding change and external evaluation
坚持现状以减少not确定性与潜在受挫

object_relations.self_representation: not够好,容易被negate的创作者与决策者
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔,可能not认可自己努力的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others suggest trying to repair/replace the glasses frames, or encourage sharing works to obtain feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将建议理解为潜在的评判与negate,担心再次受到羞辱或失望(移情:他人会像过去的朋友那样not认可自己)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉,谨慎的语气说明'现在not合适/not想显得需要或not自信'等理由,推迟或回避尝试;保持礼貌,降低情绪强度.

manifestations: 在选择新眼镜时因害怕not合适而迟迟not作决定
在艺术表达中受他人评价束缚,难以Freedom分享

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心显得'需求过多或not自信',因此not向亲密朋友分享not安
Repeated self-criticism and scrutiny before sharing one's work
Overly cautious when making choices (such as changing glasses), delaying decisions

exception_events.target_problem: 在准备将作品分享给他人时,来访者通常会产生强烈Anxiety并Anticipation负面反馈,从而回避分享或拖延.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在独自绘画的情境下,来访者have not像往常那样担心他人反馈,而是专注创作过程并体验到乐趣,Anxiety明显降低.
exception_events.reason: not同情境:仅为自己而画,have not分享计划;not同做法:将注意力放在过程而非评价,因此出现了更投入与更轻的Anxiety.

positive_force: Academic performance stable, has some self-management ability
Positive attitude, willing to try small behavioral experiments
Has one close friend as potential support
当not为他人而画时能体验到创作的乐趣
negative_force: Excessively concerned with others' evaluations, seeking external validation
Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization与心理过滤导致决策僵化
Fear of change and strong attachment to the current glasses
Avoids action, lacks concrete attempts to face problems

target_behavior.consequence: 影响日常决策与课堂注意力,造成挫败与not适

target_behavior.behavior: 在分享作品前的Anxiety与回避

回忆朋友此前not理想的反应
